outcome: activity of internal abdominal oblique/transversus abdominis muscles
cohort: The study included 27 women from 6 to 12 months after childbirth who completed a personal questionnaire and underwent a functional examination.
finding: Transversus abdominis and internal abdominal oblique muscles play an important role in stabilizing the sacroiliac area in the Active Straight Leg Rise Test, and their level of activity is similar in all tested groups.
mod_finding: The activity level of rectus abdominis muscle was similar across natural childbirth, cesarean section, and control groups, and there were no important differences in internal abdominal oblique/transversus abdominis activity between these groups.
